exact_rank_argument: A vanishing linear combination first has zero coefficient of the time column, then zero coefficient of the s column, then zero coefficient of the r column because cos²+sin²=1. Thus rank3 including r=0.
one_sided_gluing: Simultaneous(u,v)->(-u,-v) changes signed r to-r and preserves t; opposite-sector boundary annuli are paired at equal t, with the free deck involution when their normal cover is connected.
projection_check: Off Γ∪L the blowdown has one-point fibers and full spatial rank. Over each point of Γ∪L its single interval fiber has time t, giving injectivity. Reheighting is allowed only with these fibers fixed and endpointfibers/collarsretained.
